purpose: Define a CC BY and CC0-only development-listening source path that avoids unresolved noncommercial and ShareAlike decisions without treating ODAQ's simulated artifacts as codec evidence or claiming independent music-provider transfer.

primary_source_observation.paper_population: 14 music excerpts and 11 movie-like soundtrack excerpts distributed as studio-quality stereo PCM at 44.1 or 48 kHz
primary_source_observation.paper_listening_evidence: 240 processed samples rated by 26 post-screened expert listeners in two laboratories
primary_source_observation.paper_processing_boundary: five isolated artifact simulations for music and source-separation/remix systems for soundtracks; no published condition is treated as an actual codec encode

cc_by_notice_requirements: identify LossyTrace codec or anchor transformations
licence_policy.rights_caveat: CC deeds do not warrant that every publicity, privacy, moral or other right needed for a particular use is cleared; exact use remains subject to the bound source records and legal code.

selected_reference_population.selection_basis: all ODAQ listening groups already audited as CC BY or CC0 with uncoded or lossless original coding; no waveform, processed condition, score or metric informed selection

acquisition_preconditions: Commit a separate reference-only acquisition authorization binding each selected reference member's ZIP name, CRC32, compressed bytes and uncompressed bytes.
Keep every processed ODAQ condition and every listening-score member closed during reference acquisition.
Verify at least 15 GiB free on /System/Volumes/Data immediately before acquisition.
Use bounded HTTP Range requests and a private external output root; never persist the full 1,048,071,792-byte archive.
Verify each acquired WAV against its frozen ZIP metadata and inspect only PCM structure until a later stimulus-generation authority is committed.
Keep audio, member paths and private manifests out of Git.

claim_boundary.current_claim: ODAQ supplies a permissively licensed one-provider studio-music and soundtrack development source stratum; actual codec audibility, independent provider transfer and final validation remain unproven.

authorized_next_step: Freeze an exact, bounded, reference-only ODAQ acquisition plan without opening scores or processed conditions. A responsible human must still choose this narrow one-provider fallback versus wider NC/SA source breadth and declare a qualified playback chain before study stimuli or responses are authorized.
